fragment.description: Three Complete Hidden City Adventures for Hidden Courts, Monster Districts, Municipal Magic Conspiracy. Three original city campaigns: readers detained by hidden courts, nocturnal homes facing a daylight inspection and streets erased by a private spell contract.

description.value: The Library Will Not Close: Objective: release detained readers. Find the borrowing record or challenge the memory price; delay takes a recollection.
An Inspection at Sunrise: Objective: protect vulnerable tenants. Propose a night visit or stage evacuation; delay exposes the first landing.

name.value: The Street No Map Can Find

description.value: The Street No Map Can Find: Objective: reach the emergency call. Use paper directions or mark a chalk route; delay misdirects another ambulance.
A Debt in the Margin: Objective: establish readers' exit rights. Read the expired claim or recover the final sentence; delay binds another patron.
The Roof behind the Lock: Objective: restore shade access. Lift the outdated hold or escort repair cells; delay forces a risky bypass.
The Contract under the Index: Objective: identify the erasing extension. Audit payments or retrieve the archive copy; delay removes another route.
Borrowed until Tomorrow: Objective: recover the final page. Open the present return chute or renegotiate its due date; delay repeats closing.
Neighbors around One Table: Objective: organize a safe inspection. Gather witnesses or demonstrate the repaired landing; delay spreads false rumors.
The Duplicate Junction: Objective: isolate misleading routes. Compare resident maps or cut the extension feed; delay diverts rescuers.

name.value: A Sentence Both Courts Can Read

description.value: A Sentence Both Courts Can Read: Objective: repair the treaty without erasure. Preserve the annotation or witness a shared copy; delay feeds the index moth.
Shade before the Door Opens: Objective: protect dawn access. Finish the safe circuit or stage the bounded evacuation; delay injures a resident.

name.value: Who Paid to Lose a Street

description.value: Who Paid to Lose a Street: Objective: end private route control. Publish the audit or terminate the extension; delay renews the contract.
The Reader's Own Memory: Objective: return taken recollections. Release the envelopes or witness individual claims; delay merges them with the court archive.
The Evening Visit: Objective: settle a safe inspection. Verify repairs or accept a witnessed temporary plan; delay reinstates the dawn sweep.
Names Chosen by Residents: Objective: restore a usable public map. Reconnect approved routes or maintain a witnessed paper service; delay leaves a district unreachable.
After-hours without Tribute: Objective: settle the courts' treaty. Bound lending claims or guarantee independent exit rights; record the readers' retained memories.
Dawn behind Working Shades: Objective: settle the tower's safety. Share repair duties or fund tested protection; record private identities kept private.

name.value: A City that Can Find You

description.value: A City that Can Find You: Objective: maintain public route correction. Create a resident register or independent emergency copy; record who may revise it.
Closing Detention: the library seals its doors with the treaty ending missing.
Dawn Notice: the tower receives a compulsory daylight inspection time.
Address Failure: a rescue call cannot be placed on the spell map.
Memory Demand: the margin bailiff names the first reader's exit price.
Shade Outage: one landing loses protection before the roof repair begins.
Contract Renewal: the private extension silently removes another street.
Return Echo: the book chute announces a due date from tomorrow.
Night Proposal: Sol offers a safer inspection if tenants demonstrate repairs.
Paper Route: a paramedic reaches the lost junction with an offline description.
Borrower's Note: the final page contains an annotation one court wants erased.
Neighbor Supper: ordinary and nocturnal residents share evidence at the kitchen.
Audit Discovery: the budget trail names who paid for the disappearing routes.
Moth Feeding: the lending record begins losing its dates.
Roof Locked: an automated hold blocks a valid tenant repair crew.
Duplicate Junction: the route reflection sends a second ambulance away.
Sentence Recalled: Juno speaks enough of the ending to stop a memory seizure.
Inspection Witness: Kira offers documented safety without private resident names.
Feed Cut: isolating the extension temporarily interrupts one public utility.
Reader Return: a stolen recollection can be reclaimed before the treaty is rebound.
Bypass Offer: a shadeworker offers a faster repair at a stated fire risk.
Residents Assemble: neighbors choose the names and correction rights of restored streets.
Both Courts Meet: the lending dispute can be settled without replacing the page.
Safe Landing: one repaired floor allows daylight evacuation of vulnerable residents.
Extension Termination: the contract reflection demands explicit notice before shutting down.
Chute Reopened: the borrower reaches the present with the missing ending.
Evening Inspection: the safe alternative is judged on visible repairs rather than rumors.
Street Reconnected: emergency routes return under a witnessed public map.
Library Exit: patrons leave under the restored treaty and their retained memories.
Tower after Dawn: the tenants' shade agreement sets future inspection terms.
Names in Common: the city map reflects residents' final route choices.
